feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 September 2026 7:23am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 08 September 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure will drift eastwards across northern Scotland today and slowly fill, showery troughs will affect the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, veering West or Northwest this evening and increasing occasionally 7, then becoming generally Northwest 5 or 6 later tonight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough in places later today and at first tonight.


##Weather##

Scattered showers.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6, decreasing 3 or 4 through tomorrow morning, then backing West or Southwest later in the day. Backing South or Southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight, then becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
